tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Strong maximum principle with $c \geq 0$] ↗ lem:hopfs-lemma ↗ thm:strong-maximum-principle-c-zero 1. ch6:6.4-thm-4\group Maximum Principles

Assume $u \in C^2(U) \cap C(\bar U)$ and \[ c \geq 0 \quad \text{in } U. \] Suppose also $U$ is connected.

(i) If \[ Lu \leq 0 \quad \text{in } U \] and $u$ attains a nonnegative maximum over $\bar U$ at an interior point, then \[ u \text{ is constant within } U. \]

(ii) Similarly, if \[ Lu \geq 0 \quad \text{in } U \] and $u$ attains a nonpositive minimum over $\bar U$ at an interior point, then \[ u \text{ is constant within } U. \]

Proof

\sketch Repeat the tangency-ball argument for a nonnegative maximum and use part (ii) of Hopf lemma; apply the result to $-u$ for minima.

□
